question:
Let $y(x)$ satisfy: $\frac{dy}{dx} + y \tan x = \sin x$.

(a) Find the general solution for $y(x)$.
(b) Evaluate the particular solution if $y\left( \frac{\pi}{4} \right) = 2$.
(c) Determine all values of $x$ (in $-\frac{\pi}{2} < x < \frac{\pi}{2}$) where $y(x)$ attains a local minimum.

options.A:
(a) $y=\cos x\ln|\cos x|+C\cos x$
(b) $C=2\sqrt2+\frac12\ln2$
(c) Local minimum at $x=0$
options.B:
(a) $y=-\cos x\ln|\cos x|+C\sin x$
(b) $C=2\sqrt2-\frac12\ln2$
(c) Local minimum at $x=\frac{\pi}{4}$
options.C:
(a) $y=-\cos x\ln|\cos x|+C\cos x$
(b) $C=2\sqrt2+\frac12\ln2$
(c) Local minimum at $x=0$
options.D:
(a) $y=-\cos x\ln|\cos x|+C\cos x$
(b) $C=2\sqrt2-\frac12\ln2$
(c) No local minimum inside $-\frac{\pi}{2}
